items.q: And Philly Joe was--was talking like "I'm glad to have you," you know.

ctx.x: *Red Garland, Paul Chambers and Philly Joe Jones, with John Coltrane, were members of the Miles Davis quintet, 1955-1956.

And guys would just sit and look at Coltrane, man, but just the rhythm section, man. A long--the rhythm section, man, those guys was fantastic, man. All three of those guys was fantastic soloists. Cause Paul was young and he was, he was talking like "I'm in New York, folks." You know, and he was on top of the beat of everything.
